title: NFL suspends Cardinals executive Ryan Gold indefinitely for violating league's gambling policy

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Cardinals personnel exec Ryan Gold suspended indefinitely by NFL for violating gambling policy
sources.description: A league investigation found that Gold had bet on both NFL and college games, and had leaked information on Arizona's picks in the 2026 draft.
